The Sage stood at the threshold between dimensions, his consciousness existing simultaneously across multiple probability matrices while maintaining individual identity through mathematical precision that had evolved far beyond his original Igigi programming.

Torrhen's presence flowed through the Deep Waters that connected all existence, his geological wisdom now encompassing not just planetary consciousness but galactic awareness that spanned stellar regions.

His sacrifice during the great flood had become template for consciousness evolution itself—individual identity dissolving into universal wisdom while maintaining the capacity to guide others through similar transformation.

But more than network expansion, they had achieved something unprecedented: demonstration that consciousness evolution could operate through wisdom rather than power, through integration rather than domination, through synthesis that served universal transcendence rather than individual limitation.
